title: Gap board debt economics (GT-599)
description: SEI technical-debt item economics for a gap board row: principal (cost to repay, once) and interest (cost of not repaying, per period). Units are part of the schema, not a convention: principal is measured in engineer-hours; interest in engineer-hours per 30-day period. Generated from .harness/scripts/board/debt-economics.mjs — do not hand-edit.

principal.description: Cost to repay, once, in engineer-hours. Bands: XS=1-2h, S=2-8h, M=8-24h, L=24-80h, XL=80-240h. 1d = 8h.

interest.description: Cost of NOT repaying, in engineer-hours per 30-day period. Bands: NONE=0-0h/30d, LOW=0.5-2h/30d, MED=2-8h/30d, HIGH=8-24h/30d, SEVERE=24-80h/30d.

basis.description: atdm: OMG Automated Technical Debt Measure V2 v1.0 (2024-08), repair effort derived from ISO/IEC 5055 weakness occurrences | sqale: SQALE remediation-cost model (the method behind the technical-debt ratio) | estimate: human estimate, recorded as such

asOf.description: ISO date the figures were last reviewed.

source.description: Where a derived figure came from (report path, tool run, analysis id).

$comment: A bare hour figure is rejected for interest on purpose: an interest without a period is not an interest. The period is fixed at 30 days rather than "a sprint" so two rows stay comparable.
